meta.name: Send daily India eProcure tender alerts with OpenAI, Google Sheets, Telegram, Slack and Gmail

name: AI Government Tender Discovery & Daily Opportunity Alerts

parameters.content:
## 🏛️ AI Government Tender Discovery & Daily Opportunity Alerts

### How it works
Every morning at 9 AM, the workflow scrapes the eProcure portal for active government tenders, normalises the raw HTML into structured rows, and filters out any tenders already logged to avoid duplicates. New tenders are scored and summarised by a GPT-4o-mini agent — which evaluates strategic fit and win probability based on your business profile — and the top 5 are selected. Results are appended to a Google Sheet log and dispatched via three parallel channels: a Telegram alert, a Slack message, and a formatted Gmail digest. The workflow is designed to be extended with additional tender portals (GEM, CPPP, state portals) by adding parallel scraping branches.

### Setup steps
1. Connect **Google Sheets OAuth2** and create a sheet with a `Tenders Log` tab. Replace `YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID` in the Append node.
2. Connect **OpenAI API** to the AI Agent node.
3. Connect **Telegram Bot API** and replace `YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID` in the Telegram alert node.
4. Connect **Slack OAuth2** and replace `YOUR_SLACK_CHANNEL_ID` in the Slack alert node.
5. Connect **Gmail OAuth2** and update `procurement@yourcompany.com` in the Gmail digest node.
6. Edit the business profile and keywords in the AI Agent system prompt to match your sector and capabilities.
7. Activate the schedule trigger.

## 🔍 New Tender Filter
Filters out duplicate tender IDs within the current batch using an in-memory set — so the same tender is never processed twice in a single run. If none pass the filter, the flow exits early with no alerts sent.

## 🤖 AI Scoring & Top-5 Selection
The GPT-4o-mini agent evaluates each new tender for strategic fit and win probability using your business profile. The scored list is ranked and capped at the top 5 most relevant opportunities before logging and alerting.

## 📣 Log & Multi-Channel Alerts
Appends scored tenders to the Google Sheet, then fires three parallel notifications: a Telegram message for mobile alerts, a Slack message for the team channel, and an HTML Gmail digest with full tender details for the procurement inbox.

## 🔑 Credentials Required
- **Google Sheets OAuth2** — Tenders Log sheet
- **OpenAI API** — AI scoring agent
- **Telegram Bot API** — daily alert
- **Slack OAuth2** — team channel alert
- **Gmail OAuth2** — HTML digest email

Never hardcode sheet IDs, chat IDs, or personal emails in shared templates.

parameters.text:
=You are a government tender analyst. Here is a batch of newly discovered tenders in JSON:

{{ JSON.stringify($items().map(i => i.json)) }}

For each tender:
1. Give a one-line plain-English summary
2. Flag if the closing date looks urgent (within 7 days from today)
3. Note the department/category

Then produce a short overall alert message (plain text, no markdown tables) listing each new tender as a bullet with its title, department, closing date, and a 1-line summary. Keep the whole message under 3000 characters so it works for both Telegram and Slack.

parameters.content:
## ⏰ Daily Trigger & Portal Scraping
Fires at 9 AM. Initialises run metadata, fetches the eProcure portal HTML, parses the listings table with an HTML extractor, and normalises each row into a clean object with title, department, value, deadline, and URL.
